doc: One bake entry (inputs cov and extras.*), files decoded: hires = round(clip(cov) * 255) south-up (gunzipped), slice = round(box_downsample(cov, SLICE_WIDTH) * 255) (no clip: cov must be in [0, 1]), highShare = round(clip(box(high_share)) * 254), type = round(clip(box(type)) * 255), wind = encode_wind at its own grid. SLICE_WIDTH is the real 2048: the 32x64 map is narrower, so slice, highShare and type are the map itself (box_downsample returns it). The inputs are dyadic (multiples of 1/512, block means exact in float32), with blocks whose mean is a rounding tie (0.5 x 255 = 127.5 -> 128, 0.25 x 254 = 63.5 -> 64, 0.75 x 254 = 190.5 -> 190). Exact: integers. params.record is the manifest record (file names are part of the contract).

encoding.hires: R8 cloud fraction 0..255, rows SOUTH-up, gzip
encoding.slice: gray 8-bit fraction, north-up, box downsample of hires
encoding.highShare: gray 8-bit, conditional share above 440 hPa, 0..254 = 0..1 (255 reserved: none)
encoding.wind: RGB, R east / G north, m/s = (byte - 128) x 0.5
